get.summary: List raw uci sections for a package

patch.summary: Partially update a raw uci section

get.summary: Get info on an installed package

post.summary: Create a new apk feed file and run apk update

get.summary: Get one apk feed by id

delete.summary: Delete an apk feed and re-run apk update

post.summary: Set the password for a local user (write-only; shells out to passwd)
Add a single SSH public key

get.summary: Get a single SSH key by stable id

delete.summary: Remove a single SSH key by stable id

url.description: HTTP(S) URL of the package repository

user.description: Local Unix user to update; usually 'root'

password.description: New password (min 8 chars). Never echoed back.

id.description: Stable id: sha256 prefix of the public-key blob (or non-crypto djb2 fallback in test environments)

type.description: SSH key type (e.g. ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa, ecdsa-sha2-nistp256)

comment.description: Optional comment (trailing text on the key line)

FirewallRules.description: uapi resource backed by uci firewall.rule

FirewallZones.description: uapi resource backed by uci firewall.zone

masq.description: Enable IPv4 masquerading on this zone

mtu_fix.description: Clamp MSS to PMTU for traffic in this zone

FirewallRedirects.description: uapi resource backed by uci firewall.redirect

reflection.description: Enable NAT loopback / hairpinning for this redirect (fw4 default true)

reflection_src.description: Source address used for hairpinned packets: internal LAN or external WAN

reflection_zone.description: Zones in which NAT reflection is allowed (uci list reflection_zone)

FirewallForwardings.description: uapi resource backed by uci firewall.forwarding

FirewallDefaults.description: uapi resource backed by uci firewall.defaults

drop_invalid.description: Drop packets with invalid conntrack state

flow_offloading_hw.description: Enable hardware flow offloading (requires NIC support)

NetworkInterfaces.description: uapi resource backed by uci network.interface

device.description: Physical or logical L2 device this interface binds to

ipaddr.description: Static IPv4 address (single). Backward-compatible view of the first entry when uci has `list ipaddr`.

ipaddrs.description: Full IPv4 address list for static proto (uci `list ipaddr`). Preferred on write for multi-address interfaces.

ip6assign.description: Prefix length to assign downstream from a delegated prefix

auto.description: Bring this interface up at boot

private_key.description: WireGuard private key; accepted on write, masked on read

nohostroute.description: Suppress the implicit host-route for wireguard endpoint

ip4table.description: Routing table to install WireGuard IPv4 routes into

ip6table.description: Routing table to install WireGuard IPv6 routes into

peerdns.description: Accept DNS servers advertised by the upstream (dhcp/dhcpv6)

defaultroute.description: Install the default route from DHCP (dhcp)

reqprefix.description: DHCPv6 prefix-delegation request: auto, no, or numeric size

ip6hint.description: Preferred IPv6 prefix hint for PD (dhcpv6)

ip6ifaceid.description: Static IPv6 interface id for IA_NA (dhcpv6)

NetworkDevices.description: uapi resource backed by uci network.device

name.description: Device name as seen by netifd / the kernel

macaddr.description: MAC address override (colon or dash separated)

NetworkRoutes.description: uapi resource backed by uci network.route

netmask.description: IPv4 netmask if target is an address (not CIDR)

NetworkRules.description: uapi resource backed by uci network.rule

in.description: Match traffic arriving on this interface

out.description: Match traffic departing on this interface

src.description: Match source IPv4 address or CIDR

dest.description: Match destination IPv4 address or CIDR

lookup.description: Routing table id to look up when action is lookup

goto.description: Priority of the rule to jump to when action is goto

NetworkBridgeVlans.description: uapi resource backed by uci network.bridge-vlan

device.description: Parent bridge device name (must exist in network/devices type=bridge)

NetworkWireguardPeers.description: uapi resource backed by uci network.wireguard_peer

interface.description: Parent WireGuard interface (network/interfaces name with proto=wireguard)

disabled.description: Skip this peer when starting the tunnel

preshared_key.description: Optional preshared key; accepted on write, masked on read

WirelessDevices.description: uapi resource backed by uci wireless.wifi-device

htmode.description: HT/VHT/HE mode label (e.g. HT20, VHT80, HE160)

WirelessInterfaces.description: uapi resource backed by uci wireless.wifi-iface

network.description: Network interface this SSID bridges into

ssid.description: SSID broadcast (or joined in sta mode)

isolate.description: Block station-to-station traffic on this AP

key.description: Encryption passphrase; accepted on write, masked on read

has_key.description: True if a key is configured (cleartext never returned)

DhcpHosts.description: uapi resource backed by uci dhcp.host

mac.description: Primary MAC address for IPv4 reservation

mac_aliases.description: Additional MACs for the same reservation (uci list mac)

broadcast.description: Force broadcast replies for clients that need it

instance.description: Pin this reservation to a specific dhcp/dnsmasq instance (section name)

DhcpLeases.description: uapi resource backed by uci dhcp.lease

expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the lease expires

DhcpLeases6.description: uapi resource backed by uci dhcp.lease6

interface.description: Server-side interface that issued the lease

prefix_length.description: Prefix length for IA_PD; null for IA_NA

expires_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the lease expires; null for non-numeric values like 'forever'

DhcpServers.description: uapi resource backed by uci dhcp.dhcp

ra_default.description: 0 default, 1 deprecate prefix, 2 advertise as router

DhcpDnsmasq.description: uapi resource backed by uci dhcp.dnsmasq

DhcpOdhcpd.description: uapi resource backed by uci dhcp.odhcpd

maindhcp.description: Use odhcpd as the IPv4 DHCP server too

leasefile.description: Path where odhcpd persists active leases

System.description: uapi resource backed by uci system.system

description.description: Free-form system description shown in LuCI

SystemTimeservers.description: uapi resource backed by uci system.timeserver

enable_server.description: Also serve time to LAN clients

interface.description: Bind sysntpd to a specific network interface

use_dhcp.description: Accept NTP servers learned via DHCP option 42

DropbearInstances.description: uapi resource backed by uci dropbear.dropbear

UhttpdInstances.description: uapi resource backed by uci uhttpd.uhttpd

no_symlinks.description: Refuse to follow symlinks under home

rfc1918_filter.description: Reject requests from RFC1918 ranges with non-RFC1918 host header

UhttpdCerts.description: uapi resource backed by uci uhttpd.cert

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (case-insensitive; normalized to uppercase on write)

UnboundServer.description: uapi resource backed by uci unbound.unbound

add_local_fqdn.description: How aggressively to add local FQDNs (0..4)

add_wan_fqdn.description: How aggressively to add WAN FQDNs (0..4)

interface_auto.description: Bind to all interfaces (interface-automatic: yes). Disable to bind manually via /etc/unbound/unbound_srv.conf.

rebind_protection.description: 0 = off, 1 = private nets, 2 = all rebind attacks blocked

domain_type.description: Local-zone type for the configured domain

SqmQueues.description: uapi resource backed by uci sqm.queue

enabled.description: Whether SQM is active on this interface

interface.description: Network interface name SQM applies to

overhead.description: Per-packet overhead bytes for link-layer accounting

SnmpdAgents.description: uapi resource backed by uci snmpd.agent

SnmpdCom2secs.description: uapi resource backed by uci snmpd.com2sec

secname.description: security name this community maps to

SnmpdGroups.description: uapi resource backed by uci snmpd.group

group.description: Group name referenced by snmpd/accesses entries

secname.description: Security name (community for v1/v2c, USM user for v3)

SnmpdAccesses.description: uapi resource backed by uci snmpd.access

group.description: snmpd group this access entry binds to (must exist in snmpd/groups)

read.description: View name granted for read access

write.description: View name granted for write access

SnmpdSystem.description: uapi resource backed by uci snmpd.system

LldpdConfig.description: uapi resource backed by uci lldpd.lldpd

lldp_mgmt_ip.description: Management IP advertised in LLDP frames

listen_ipv6.description: Listen on IPv6 in addition to IPv4

listen_interface.description: Bind to a specific network interface (uci interface name)

VnstatConfig.description: uapi resource backed by uci vnstat.vnstat

interface_5min_hours.description: How many hours of 5-minute granularity data to keep

month_rotate.description: Day of month that monthly counters roll over

VnstatInterfaces.description: uapi resource backed by uci vnstat.interface

interface.description: Network interface to track (must exist in network/interfaces)

bearerAuth.description: Token created via uapi-token on the router. Hashed (salted sha256) at rest.

Locked.description: Another write transaction holds the global lock
